alerts.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued August 22 at 10:45PM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
alerts.desc:
The areas affected include...
Tidal Potomac from Indian Head to Cobb Island MD...
Tidal Potomac from Key Bridge to Indian Head MD...

At 1045 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated strong thunderstorms, capable
of producing winds to around 30 knots. These thunderstorms were
located along a line extending from 9 nm west of Alexandria to near
Mason Neck State Park to near Smallwood State Park, moving east at 15
knots.
